legacy_data_policy: All earlier plan_tuning measurements are pilot evidence only. No old timings, confirmation rounds, or labels enter this study's estimators, models, or headline evidence.

source.instrumentation: Generated independent header overrides and a separate harness; record original and generated source hashes, patch manifest, binary SHA256.

scope.hardware_caps: Query the selected real device; do not override thread/shared-memory/warp caps or use fake pointers.

questions.question: For the declared legal tested candidates, where and by how much does the library default lose?
questions.evidence: Complete screening matrix plus frozen screen selections independently remeasured; report no improvement, regressions, and failures.
questions.nonclaim: The fastest tested candidate is not a global algorithmic oracle.

questions.question: Which requested controls change actual structures, and do the same candidate IDs change rank with N or batch?
questions.evidence: Requested/resolved/core-structure/source-compiler fingerprints; predetermined same-candidate batch contrasts; independently confirmed crossovers.
questions.nonclaim: Descriptor equality does not prove identical kernels; a structural association alone does not identify a single causal mechanism.

questions.question: What do planning, resource preparation, code generation, compilation and loading cost, and can all tested smooth-1D structures actually be obtained without compilation?
questions.evidence: Nested timing spans; actual describe-only counter checks and full-build equivalence; same-context construction pipelines with cleanup.
questions.nonclaim: A compile-time snapshot is not a plan-only implementation; known-winner construction is not a deployed learned selector.

questions.question: Do precompile structural features help select candidates across held-out N in this small domain?
questions.evidence: Fixed model and feature ablations with grouped held-out N; selection regret and default-relative performance.
questions.nonclaim: Learning results cannot replace H1-H3 or establish cross-GPU/general FFT generalization.

design_rationale.workloads: Fixed length families and both single/large batches, with four intermediate batches around relevant stage boundaries. No N is added after seeing performance.
design_rationale.candidate_policy: Fixed stratified contrasts of legal implementation controls. All 26 requests run on all 36 workloads, even when a setting folds to another plan; no timing-based pruning.
design_rationale.coalesced_memory: A documented user-overridable scheduling hint, varied only over safe positive multiples of complex element size; queried device caps remain unchanged.
design_rationale.reorder_exclusion: API guide states disableReorderFourStep omits the final transpose; including it would change the natural-order task.
design_rationale.forced_pass_thresholds: The 8192 and 65536 values are implementation-policy thresholds, not fabricated hardware limits; below a threshold the request may collapse to default.
design_rationale.coverage_limit: 26 controls are a bounded tested set, not exhaustive coverage of VkFFT's design space. Report actual unique source/core classes and any uncovered dimensions.

candidate_field_semantics.zero: For these VkFFT request fields, zero leaves library automatic/default behavior. Preserve all requested values and separately report resolved values.
candidate_field_semantics.negative_control: default_replica is a separate fresh process with the same empty tuning request as default. Exclude it from selection, model training and optimization objectives.
candidate_field_semantics.explicit_default: a128_r1_lm1 tests explicit default-like settings; do not assume equality without source/compiled-input and resolved audits.
candidate_field_semantics.invalid: Any initialization, compilation, numerical, natural-order, immutability or resource-budget failure is retained. Such a request is not an eligible timed candidate for that workload; never silently replace it.

source_evidence.finding: coalescing/aim overrides, coupled LUT modes, reorder behavior, nonpow2 boost, pass thresholds; registerBoost4Step is forcibly reset.
coalescing changes strided capacity; NP gate collapses boost; swap thresholds force upload counts.
disableReorderFourStep omits final transpose and changes output ordering.
batch folding; resource preparation; block layout; codegen; immediate compile; final axis normalization.

stages.purpose: Freeze source/instrumentation, validate numerical/reference/graph/counter behavior and guard. No research performance claim from validation probes.
Execute all 36x26 screening attempts with frozen per-workload graph repeats; emit a complete validity/coverage ledger.
Freeze screen winner, core-distinct alternative, global candidate and headline-selection inputs, then independently confirm all workloads in three process rounds.
Execute fixed eight-workload cost profiles and actual describe/full consistency checks; independent of execution-performance ranking.
Freeze at most six headline workloads from S1/S2 by deterministic rules and perform ten new paired process rounds.
Report H1-H3 including negative evidence; run H4 once if its data-coverage gate holds. End this round without automatically adding sizes or dimensions.

semantic_probes.purpose: Numerical/immutable-input/graph correctness only; these event times are not research performance evidence.

cost_smoke.purpose: Engineering zero-counter and descriptor/source consistency gate; kept separate from S3 cost estimates.

preflight.failure: A default numerical failure, reference failure, graph serialization error, full-vs-describe inconsistency, or trace corruption must stop the affected stage. Candidate-specific illegal/resource/numerical failures are preserved in the complete attempt ledger. If describe-only cannot pass, H1/H2 may use full mode with H3 feasibility explicitly unresolved.

measurement.execution_metric: Median CUDA-event interval of a serialized graph containing R forward calls, divided by R. It is repeated immutable-input steady-state graph latency for this working set; not isolated-call latency or host API latency.
measurement.graph: Use actual start/stop graph event-record nodes on the single stream; each forward follows the previous forward's final nodes. For this bounded smooth1D matrix, require captured kernel count = R times numAxisUploads and exactly two external event nodes. A mismatch rejects the measurement rather than silently assuming the dispatch count; any later scope requiring split dispatches needs a separate measured R=1 baseline and protocol amendment.

repeats.calibration: Fresh default candidate only, target raw median interval >=0.5ms, cap2048, at most3 total probes including initial R=1. Adjustment may use ceil(1.1*target_ms/observed_per_fft_ms). Freeze the last actually measured R, retain below-target flags, and save all probes for every candidate and later remeasurement of that workload.
repeats.cap_flag: If cap prevents target, keep flagged result and quantify timer granularity; do not recalibrate on winners.

measurement.restore: Restore the same host input before each graph sample outside event timing; R calls within a graph reuse immutable input. Verify bitwise input stability after one call and repeated graph.
measurement.process_order: Randomly permute N blocks using a frozen seed, then batch blocks within N. Within each screening workload, default first and default_replica last bracket a seeded random permutation of the 24 other requests. A block's requests are consecutive; no global interleaving of thousands of rows.
measurement.confirmation_order: Within each workload/round, default and replica bracket seeded-random selected candidates; alternate which baseline ID is first by round. Alternate/seed the order of batch blocks across rounds. Only process medians are independent replications.
measurement.seed_derivation: SHA256 UTF-8 of seed_namespace + ':' + phase + ':' + workload_id + ':' + round_index; first 4 bytes interpreted little-endian uint32. Same input seed across candidates in a paired block. Separate seed namespaces for screen, confirmation, headline and validation.

correctness.zero_input: Exact zero output; handle denominator separately.
correctness.reference: Independent CPU FP64 reference for each tested N, with exact FP32 input representation and batch-specific scale/DC transformation. All output elements and every transform checked after one forward and after repeated graph.
correctness.preflight: Retain independent small direct-DFT reference checks and fixed zero/impulse/constant/quarter-tone GPU probes. For new forced-stage/coalescing/NP paths require natural-order correctness before accepting timings. Check random-input full-output against CPU reference for every candidate; analytic probes supplement this.
correctness.threshold_policy: Do not relax thresholds after seeing candidate errors. A failure is an observed limitation/failure within the tested space, not proof of a timing benefit.

guard.foreign_compute: Any compute PID outside the verified process tree on the selected UUID invalidates the overlapping process, stops the run, and preserves evidence. Do not touch other users' processes.
guard.memory_cap_semantics: Predeclared total selected-GPU budget, including context and display baseline. An otherwise valid candidate exceeding it is resource-budget-ineligible; do not call it mathematically invalid. Record own allocations and total memory. No adaptive threshold based on timings.
guard.process_polling: Capture pre/post state plus periodic observations; state the finite polling blind spot. Instrumentation/driver errors are explicit.
guard.negative_control_gate: In every block require default and replica source/compiler-input fingerprints equal, and absolute log(default_median/replica_median) <= log(1.05). Any violation quarantines the whole block for review, never only the faster/slower row.
guard.drift_gate: If first- vs last-quartile sample median differs by >5% in either direction, flag the block as nonstationary; do not present its apparent winner as settled evidence.
guard.resume: No automatic continuation through competition. After guard or control failure, preserve all rows; require 30s quiet and a fresh health gate. A partial block lacking its closing replica is never accepted by prefix-splicing: repeat the entire block as a new attempt and count it against the two-block retry cap, even without a recorded interference incident. Complete accepted blocks may resume. At most two whole screening blocks may be repeated; retain original and replacement IDs. Beyond this budget, stop and report incomplete coverage rather than silently mask/reselect.

health_gate.criteria: All numerical/guard checks pass; each workload geometric-mean ratio within2% of1 and all individual paired ratios within5%; no >5% early/late drift. If a gate fails, stop pending explicit new design.

selection.eligible: Guard-clean, within resource budget, initialization/compile/correctness passed; exclude default_replica from all selection objectives.
selection.screen_winner: Minimum screen process median among eligible candidates including default; exact numerical ties choose default then lexicographic candidate_id. This is an optimistic tested-set screen oracle, not the primary independently estimated effect.
selection.source_class: Ordered per-upload generated-source hash plus compiler options/architecture plus logical binding/layout metadata. Never use a small descriptor hash as a synonym for identical kernels.
selection.alternative: Fastest eligible candidate whose source class and core projection both differ from the screen winner; skip if none exists. LUT-only differences do not satisfy core-distinct alternative.
selection.global: Among candidates valid on every one of the36 workloads, choose minimum equal-workload mean log(t_candidate/t_default), excluding replica. Tie default then candidate_id. Freeze before independent confirmation; report absence if no nondefault is globally eligible.
selection.confirmation_candidates: Union of default, screen_winner, alternative and global, deduplicated by candidate_id, plus separate default_replica.
selection.primary_effect: For the frozen screen winner, exp(mean over3 independent rounds of log(t_default/t_winner))). If winner=default, the selection effect is1 by definition, not a fabricated paired statistical test.
selection.confirmed_best_caveat: The minimum among several candidates measured in confirmation is a further selected estimate. Label it descriptive only; do not substitute it for the frozen-winner primary effect.
selection.aggregates: Show every workload and N-grouped summaries, equal-workload geometric mean and distribution, paired-round variability and regressions. Main population is these36 deliberately selected workloads, not a random sample of all FFT uses.

report: requested -> resolved -> core descriptor -> source/compiler-input class counts per workload
unique classes gained by NP/coalescing/LUT4/forced-stage groups
class-based latency distributions and same-source controls

predeclared_batch_contrasts.batches: single vs large; also fixed middle batches where present

structure_analysis.crossover: Must use exactly the same two requested candidate IDs at both workloads. A reversal of ranks within2% is a near tie; an exploratory material crossover requires opposing >=5% screen/confirmation point effects and then independent headline testing of both directions.
structure_analysis.interpretation: Use structure change as a mechanistic explanation supported by measured dispatch, source and resource data; do not attribute all gain to upload count while other generated code changes simultaneously.

hardware_counter_profile.purpose: Explain fixed candidate/batch contrasts using measured DRAM/L2 traffic, achieved occupancy, launch dimensions and compiled resources.
hardware_counter_profile.capture: Separate Nsight Compute run; profile one forward's complete upload sequence after warmup using an explicit profiler range. No profiling of all graph repetitions or sample loops.
hardware_counter_profile.metrics: Resolve available metrics on the installed ncu version; freeze exact names before profile data. Record tool version, replay mode, cache-control mode and collection passes; sum traffic across all uploads for one forward.
hardware_counter_profile.guard: Only run after the guard explicitly verifies all profiler child/descendant processes as belonging to this task. No blanket allowance for arbitrary GPU PIDs.
hardware_counter_profile.limits: Profiler timings are never merged into primary event timings. Replay/cache policy can change observed cache state; counters explain this profiled regime and cannot alone prove the cause of unprofiled runtime differences.
hardware_counter_profile.fallback: If safe descendant tracking or bounded capture is unavailable, record not performed and restrict mechanism claims. Do not add other profiler cases or delay core conclusions indefinitely.

selection_order: 1: workload with largest S2 frozen-winner/default geometric-mean speedup.
2: highest remaining such speedup at a different N with a core structure change; prefer a different odd-part family (1,3,5).

3-4: same-N single/large-batch pair with an exact same-candidate-ID crossover; maximize weaker opposing direction, require both point ratios>=1.05. Prefer prespecified boost-vs-default contrast; use remaining prespecified contrasts next. If none qualifies, skip these slots.
5: workload with worst S2 frozen screen-winner effect (largest regression, or least gain if no regression).
6: default-screen-best workload with the lower median N then lower batch; if none, workload whose confirmed selected effect is closest to1.
headline.tie_break: Numeric N, numeric batch, candidate_id; deduplicate workloads. Do not fill empty slots with additional winners. Freeze every pair/direction to be tested in a signed manifest.
headline.candidates: default, frozen selected candidate(s), required crossover counterpart, and default_replica. Reuse original R and all measurement settings; fresh inputs and fresh processes.

statistics.unit: paired process median, never the101 graph samples
statistics.interval: ordinary paired-log Student-t95% interval shown as descriptive interval
statistics.test: one-sided paired-log Student-t; Holm correction across all predeclared directional benefit tests in the headline manifest
statistics.clear_gain: point geometric-mean ratio>=1.05 AND Holm-adjusted p<0.05 against the2% null, plus valid negative controls and guard
statistics.zero_variance: If paired-log range <=16*float64_epsilon*max(1,maxabs(logratios)), report noninferential/quantization-limited, no fabricated t/p/CI; retain p=1 in Holm family counting only.
statistics.negative_control: default_replica comparisons are quality diagnostics, never benefit hypotheses and never counted as performance wins.
statistics.crossover_claim: Both opposing directions must independently satisfy clear_gain; otherwise exploratory reversal only.

headline.no_extension: End after these fixed ten rounds, including null results. Do not add rounds until significance or add boundary N after viewing outcomes.

cost_profile.context: One initialized CUDA primary context per pipeline process. Construct and destroy each candidate sequentially. Report context bootstrap separately; no binary-import cache in full construction. Do not sum separate-process initialization costs and call it same-context search.

pipelines.full: Construct all26 requests fully in the frozen candidate permutation, recording every span and cleanup. This is all-candidate construction cost; actual GPU benchmarking/search-decision cost is separate.
pipelines.describe_selected: Describe all26 in the identical permutation and cleanup each draft, then fully construct/destroy the frozen S1 winner. Winner is supplied from offline screening; label this a known-choice construction lower bound, not an online learned selection demonstration.

cost_profile.order: Pair the two pipeline modes within each workload/round; alternate mode order across rounds and seed candidate permutation by workload/round. Fresh process per pipeline, same context retained within it. Record the first and subsequent NVRTC/module operations.
cost_profile.accounting: Keep span ID/parent, monotonic start/end, inclusive and exclusive wall times. Sum exclusive categories for reconciliation; never sum overlapping inclusive times. Preserve unattributed residual. API host time is not necessarily device completion time; no artificial sync between every stage. Explicit final sync belongs to its own measured boundary.
cost_profile.cold_warm: Use 'fresh process/context, first operation' and 'later operation in same context'; do not claim OS/compiler/driver cache coldness. Record cache environment, CUDA/driver/NVRTC versions and compiler options.
cost_profile.describe_contract: Restricted smooth1D scope, layout and host codegen reused; skip CompileKernel and return before app tail temp allocation. Allowed LUT allocation/H2D must be timed and cleaned. Entire call chain compile/module-load/kernel-launch counts must all be zero. Reject auxiliary FFT paths before side effects.
cost_profile.equivalence: For every candidate on each fixed cost workload, compare describe vs full canonical value descriptor, ordered source hashes and compiler inputs. Ignore addresses/module handles and transient buffer-update flags. Confirm immutable original request (including batch and buffer capacities) is used on full reconstruction.
cost_profile.failure_policy: If describe-only implementation or equivalence fails, retain failures and report H3 feasibility unresolved/limited. H1/H2 may continue on the full path; never relabel precompile traces as successful zero-compile construction.
outputs: absolute ms per stage and pipeline
fraction of full setup in compilation/loading vs other work
actual describe overhead and retained resource cost
all26 vs source-deduplicated hypothetical lower-bound counts, clearly separated
execution-count amortization using measured setup and execution deltas
cost_profile.amortization: For a fixed candidate use ceil(max(0, setup_candidate-setup_default)/(exec_default-exec_candidate)) only if execution delta>0, and state setup policy. For search construction include all candidate setup plus separately measured benchmarking/selection costs. No finite break-even claim when delta<=0 or unresolved.

learning.gate: Use only fully guard-clean complete screening workloads and legal candidates; publish exact coverage. At least12 distinct N groups required. Do not impute invalid/contaminated latency or turn valid flags into inference features.
learning.target_primary: log(t_candidate/t_default) computed from training workload labels only; default timing is never an inference feature.
learning.target_secondary: log(t_candidate) sensitivity analysis, prespecified and not chosen based on outcome.
excluded_features: source hash as an arbitrary memorization ID
learning.split: 4-fold grouped by exact N, all batches/candidates for an N in the same fold; sorted N assigned round-robin to folds before fitting. Additional odd-part-family holdout is exploratory due few families.
learning.model: ExtraTreesRegressor, n_estimators=256, max_depth=8, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=1.0, random_state=20261027; same capacity/splits for every ablation, no tuning on held-out groups.
learning.comparison: Include default, S1 global policy, and all-candidate screen oracle upper-bound diagnostic. For a leakage-free held-out global baseline, select the fixed candidate using training workloads only.
metrics: regret to fastest tested held-out candidate
fraction within2% and5% of held-out tested-set minimum
top2/top4 hypothetical shortlist oracle (not real online cost savings)
learning.limitations: Sixteen N groups and one GPU support only an auxiliary domain-limited check. Row counts do not equal independent workload evidence. Null/weak ML results do not show that all structural models are useless.

budgets.stop_after: One complete preregistered sequence or a defined validity/resource/competition stop. No automatic extra candidate/grid/model sweep.

required_artifacts: study report with H1-H4 separately assessed
reporting.positive: Only guard-valid independently remeasured selected-case effects support stable gains. Use exact domain and metric labels.
reporting.negative: Report default-near-best domains, successful candidates that regress, request folding, invalid/resource-excluded controls, no clear crossover, insignificant headline tests, expensive describe/codegen/resource stages, and no demonstrable model advantage.
conclusion_levels: H1 robust repeated gap exists only where independent evidence supports it
H2 structure dependence/crossover requires same candidate identities and both directions
H3 zero-compile feasibility and measured setup savings each need their own evidence
H4 remains supplementary, even if positive
reporting.incomplete: If validity or implementation blocks completion, state which questions remain open; do not make the missing experiment disappear or reuse pilot claims as replacement.
